source.text:
study("UCTPROBE_VW_CS2_BOOL_NA_V1_CUM", overlay=false)

// PROVENANCE: written 2026-11-15 for the Pine parity programme, capture session S17
// (objects-lane PROBES-NEXT.md item 9, engine 56 review item 2). The S1 bool-na probe
// (vw-cs1-bool-na-v2/v4/v5) at //@version=1: NO version header, so TradingView reads it as v1.
// Bool-na rule A3 on the warm-up bars where na_s = sma(close, 20) is na. B rows are encoded
// 1 = true, 0 = false, -1 = na(x); R rows read the same value as plain x ? 1 : 0. H rows: an
// OFFSET of a value form, (c != false)[1] and x, and c[1] ? 1 : 0.
// S18 -cum copy: the bar-index control is cum(1) - 1 instead of n, so an engine without `n` can grade it.
// CAPTURE: NYSE:RDDT 1D from the listing, inputs at defaults.

na_s = sma(close, 20)
c = close > na_s
x = close > open
cf = c != false
enc(v) => na(v) ? -1 : v ? 1 : 0
raw(v) => v ? 1 : 0

plot(cum(1) - 1, title="A00_bar_index_CONTROL")
plot(na_s, title="A01_na_s")
plot(na(na_s) ? 1 : 0, title="A02_na_s_is_na")
plot(enc(c), title="B00_c")
plot(enc(c == false), title="B01_c_eq_false")
plot(enc(c != false), title="B02_c_ne_false")
plot(enc(c == true), title="B03_c_eq_true")
plot(enc(not c), title="B04_not_c")
plot(enc(c and true), title="B05_c_and_true")
plot(enc(c or true), title="B06_c_or_true")
plot(enc(c and false), title="B07_c_and_false")
plot(enc(c or false), title="B08_c_or_false")
plot(raw(c), title="RB00_c")
plot(raw(c == false), title="RB01_c_eq_false")
plot(raw(c != false), title="RB02_c_ne_false")
plot(raw(c == true), title="RB03_c_eq_true")
plot(raw(not c), title="RB04_not_c")
plot(raw(c and true), title="RB05_c_and_true")
plot(raw(c or true), title="RB06_c_or_true")
plot(raw(c and false), title="RB07_c_and_false")
plot(raw(c or false), title="RB08_c_or_false")
plot(enc(cf[1] and x), title="H00_cf_off1_and_x")
plot(raw(cf[1] and x), title="H01_cf_off1_and_x_raw")
plot(c[1] ? 1 : 0, title="H02_c_off1_ternary")
plot(enc(c[1]), title="H03_c_off1")

xIndex.unit: an object x is a position in `indexes`; each entry is a model bar index (mainSeries().bars()); `times` is that bar's time (unix-s), null off the loaded bars
